title: 第八章 操场上的红衣男人
slug: 看见罪犯词条我成了警局团宠
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

黎雾到嘴边的拒绝落下。

楼上才出了凶杀案，自己一个人回家收拾东西确实有点怕。

有陆云铮陪着，稍微安全一点。

做完笔录回到幸福小苑，收拾好东西，没有丝毫犹豫，直接去到了云城一中。

走入云城一中，入目的是冲天的灰尘。

陆云铮眉头皱了皱，黎雾率先解释道：

“学校规划修一栋新的宿舍楼，顺带再把操场重新给修整一下。”

“现在施工还没有结束，也不知道要弄到什么时候。”

声音中带着淡淡的吐槽。

陆云铮闻言也忍不住轻笑道：

“我读书那个时候也是这样。”

“每年都是快毕业的时候学校就维修升级，罪都留给我们受了，好条件全让学弟学妹们享受。”

黎雾闻言眼睛瞬间就亮了起来，有种找到同类认可的感觉，不爽吐槽道：

“我现在住的宿舍，一个房间放十个床位。”

“人都快挤不下了。”

人实在是太多了。

东西也多，每个人作息习惯又完全不一样。

黎雾实在是受不了才会出去租房生活。

陆云铮认可的点了点头，感叹道：

“我读书那个时候更苦，一个宿舍住十几个人。”

“两个宿舍闹起来，直接就能发展成部落冲突。”

“好了，不说了，你先去铺床，我去找王校长聊聊。”

刚刚在来的路上，陆云铮已经帮黎雾这边主动联系好了校方，提前给安排好了空床位。

黎雾点头朝陆云铮道谢之后，转身离开。

陆云铮目送着黎雾离开的背影。

如无意外，接下来除了给黎雾送线索奖励，他和黎雾不会再有其他见面可能。

陆云铮皱了皱眉，心中对于黎雾的好奇感愈浓。

他确信自己没有感受错，真的察觉到黎雾在隐藏着一个极其重要的秘密。

派人把黎雾的身份查了又查，又偏偏没有查出任何异样。

或许该去找校长谈一谈，让学校的老师注意一下。

“平时让老师帮忙多照顾一下黎雾，注意下她的动静。”

校长办公室

Page (1/3)

The refusal dropped from Li Wu's mouth.

There had just been a murder upstairs, and I was really scared to go home and pack my things alone.

With Lu Yunzheng accompanying him, it was a little safer.

After finishing the notes, I returned to Xingfu Garden, packed my things, and went directly to Yuncheng No. 1 Middle School without any hesitation.

When I walked into Yuncheng No. 1 Middle School, I saw dust rising into the sky.

Lu Yunzheng frowned, and Li Wu took the lead in explaining:

"The school plans to build a new dormitory building and renovate the playground."

“The construction is not over yet, and we don’t know when it will be completed.”

There was a hint of complaint in his voice.

Lu Yunzheng couldn't help but chuckle when he heard this:

"It was the same when I was studying."

"Every year when we are about to graduate, the school is repaired and upgraded, and we are left to suffer the consequences. The good conditions are all for the juniors and girls to enjoy."

Li Wu's eyes lit up instantly when he heard this, and he felt like he had found recognition from his peers, and complained unhappily:

"The dormitory I live in now has ten beds in one room."

“It’s almost too crowded to squeeze in.”

There are just too many people.

There are a lot of things, and everyone’s work and rest habits are completely different.

Li Wu went out to rent a house because he couldn't bear it anymore.

Lu Yunzheng nodded in approval and sighed:

"It was even more difficult when I was studying. There were more than a dozen people living in one dormitory."

"If two dormitories get into trouble, it can directly develop into a tribal conflict."

"Okay, no more talking, you go make the bed first, and I'll go talk to Principal Wang."

On the way here just now, Lu Yunzheng had already helped Li Wu contact the school and arranged an empty bed in advance.

Li Wu nodded and thanked Lu Yunzheng, then turned and left.

Lu Yunzheng watched Li Wu leave.

If nothing unexpected happens, apart from giving clue rewards to Li Wu, there will be no other possibility for him and Li Wu to meet again.

Lu Yunzheng frowned, his curiosity about Li Wu getting stronger.

He was sure that his feelings were not wrong, and he really realized that Li Wu was hiding an extremely important secret.

Someone was sent to check Li Wu's identity again and again, but nothing unusual was found.

Maybe you should talk to the principal and let the school teachers pay attention.

"Usually ask the teacher to help take more care of Li Wu and pay attention to her movements."

Principal's Office
